title: Herrera attends Greer's CE5 sessions

tellings.quote: Well, I think that's what Dr. Greer's whole C5 initiative is all about which I've personally attended a few of them.

plain: Michael Herrera, a guest who says he once saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he has gone to several of the group sessions run by a UFO researcher named Steven Greer. In these sessions, which Greer calls CE5, people try to make contact with UFOs on purpose. Herrera brings it up himself as someone who took part, while talking with Jesse Michels about what Greer's effort is really for.
